title: WatchObservationRecordedPayload
description: watch.observation.recorded v1 (OpenVibe.Watch, plan T18): a check recorded an observation for a watch. It carries the extracted value as the source stated it and its hash, never the raw body. Envelope: subject { type: watch, id: <watch_id> }, visibility internal, priority low, actor service:watch. Watch's own records are the full observation (watch.observation@1); this event is the notification that one exists.

owner.description: The watch owner's subject id: who this observation is for.

value.description: The extracted value as the source stated it; null when it stated none.

value_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical value.
